SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

4. Which statement about Population distribution in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population distribution in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Population distribution in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Explain Population distribution in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage.

   C. Say Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage as rumours only.

7. Which statement about The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Treat The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui as rumours only.
   C. Say The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui.

8. Which statement about School administration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat School administration as rumours only.

   C. Skip evidence when discussing School administration.
   D. Explain School administration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   D. Explain Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Development of Transport is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Development of Transport with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Development of Transport.
   C. Say Development of Transport never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Development of Transport as rumours only.

11. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

12. Which statement about African Traditional Education is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat African Traditional Education as rumours only.
